channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alfonzo McKinnie | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alfonzo McKinnie from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kirk Lacob on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, Alfonzo McKinnie
item.description:
Warriors assistant general manager Kirk Lacob said.

“All of a sudden you look at it and Steph [Curry] is the oldest player on the whole team. Klay [Thompson]and Draymond [Green] are the elder statesmen. I think Alfonzo McKinnie (26) may be our fourth-oldest player by age. He's only had a couple years of NBA experience.”

Kirk Lacob on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, Alfonzo McKinnie, Jul 31, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie
item.description:
Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie:

“I didn't even know he played for Toronto last year. When he showed up at camp I had to ask where he's from. They told me he played with the Raptors in the G League... But he had a great camp and earned his way onto the team. Great story.”

Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie, May 30, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie:

“He's been the perfect fit. We couldn't be happier with what he's doing.”

Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie, Nov 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie
item.description:
KC Johnson:Steve Kerr on Marshall High product Alfonzo McKinnie, who's in Warriors' rotation:

“He’s been through quite a bit trying to get to this point. And I think our players have a lot of respect for his journey, but also the way he carries himself. He’s very professional, hard-working”

Steve Kerr on Alfonzo McKinnie, Oct 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
